description:
About Us 1GLOBAL

is a technology-driven global mobile communications provider, delivering global connectivity solutions to enterprises and consumers. Powered by a best-in-class telecom platform – including its own owned and operated global mobile core network, fully fledged in-house developed eSIM technology, and an extensive portfolio of telecom licenses – 1GLOBAL operates as a fully regulated telecommunications provider across 40 countries worldwide.

We serve many of the world’s leading banks, enterprises, and digital‑first businesses, including neo‑banks, global fast moving consumer goods companies, travel leaders, and payment service providers. Today, 1GLOBAL connects more than 70 million people and devices globally , enabling our customers to launch, scale, and innovate with confidence in the mobile ecosystem.

1GLOBAL is a profitable, fast‑growing business. With full‑year revenues in 2025 exceeding US$200 million and profits of over US$25 million , we generate strong cash flows to fund our growth allowing us to continuously invest in infrastructure, platform innovation, and global expansion. Recent years have marked a defining phase in our journey, with major enterprise and mass‑consumer client wins accelerating our evolution into a global mobile connectivity powerhouse, purpose‑built to enable consumer brands to enter and succeed with their own aspirations to offer telecommunications services to their clients.

Founded in 2022 by experienced technology entrepreneurs, Hakan Koç and Pyrros Koussios, 1GLOBAL has rapidly emerged as a European technology leader shaping the future of global telecommunications . We operate as a fully regulated Mobile Virtual Network Operator (MVNO) in 12 countries and as a regulated telecom operator in an additional 28 markets. Headquartered in the Netherlands, with world‑class R&D hubs in Lisbon, Berlin, and São Paulo, our team of close to 500 experts across 15 countries is united by a single ambition: to redefine global mobile connectivity through technology, scale, and execution excellence.

About the Team

You will be joining a dynamic team at the forefront of developing and maintaining our Network API, xSIM Management System, and Recording Platforms. The Network API powers critical systems and services that enable the creation, configuration, and real‑time monitoring of subscriber configurations across a wide array of business scenarios. These include enterprise solutions, IoT deployments, regulatory compliance, and recording services, ensuring seamless connectivity for everyone and everything. Our xSIM Management System is a high‑performance, low‑latency platform designed to handle hundreds of transactions per second, keeping all xSIMs accurately updated in real time. Meanwhile, our Recording Platforms deliver robust Mobile Compliance & Recording capabilities tailored for financial institutions, automatically capturing client and employee interactions either on‑premises or through our secure cloud infrastructure. We run a multi‑site platform, following strict security requirements, provide the service to customers around the world and manage millions of subscriber profiles. We embrace a highly collaborative and diverse environment, value teamwork, autonomy and hold ourselves accountable for our deliverables and customer success.

About the Role

  • Provide accurate effort estimates to support roadmap planning and effective expectation management
  • Design and implement resilient, scalable, secure, and fault‑tolerant architectures to ensure system reliability and performance
  • Develop new features and support existing systems across the Network API, xSIM Management System, and Recording Platforms
  • Contribute with small, incremental enhancements that seamlessly integrate into the established codebases
  • Maintain and update existing solutions to keep them modern, efficient, and reliable
  • Collaborate with team members to ensure smooth development processes and shared understanding
  • Write and maintain comprehensive tests to ensure fast regression and reliable validation of new features
  • Implement procedures and metrics to enable effective monitoring and observability of platform contributions
  • Participate in code reviews to promote high standards of code quality, readability, and maintainability
  • Take ownership of the quality and outcomes of your work, ensuring fully functional end‑to‑end flows
  • Create and maintain accurate, up‑to‑date technical documentation
  • Actively contribute to team discussions, with a mindset for continuous improvement and openness to new ideas or technologies

Requirements

About You

Must-haves

  • 6+ years of professional experience in backend development, preferably with Go (Golang). Strong Java experience with willing to learn Go is also welcome
  • Strong understanding of concurrency models, with practical experience in implementing asynchronous workflows, inter‑process communication, and synchronisation techniques
  • Skilled in designing, building, and consuming RESTful APIs, following best practices for API design and performance optimisation
  • Proven experience working with databases, both relational (e.g., PostgreSQL) and non‑relational (e.g., Redis, MongoDB, DynamoDB), including data modelling, query optimisation, and performance tuning
  • Experienced in writing unit tests, integration tests, and benchmarks, with a test‑driven development mindset
  • Comfortable with networking protocols and distributed communication patterns (e.g., gRPC, WebSockets, TCP/UDP)
  • Experienced in building scalable microservices architectures and distributed systems
  • Knowledgeable in applying software engineering best practices and design patterns for maintainable, testable code.
  • Skilled in using DevOps tools and practices, including Docker, CI/CD pipelines, and Infrastructure as Code
  • Familiar with Git workflows and collaborative development processes such as pull requests, code reviews, and agile methodologies
  • Demonstrated accountability for technical outcomes and ownership of end‑to‑end feature delivery
  • Effective communicator in English, both written and verbal, suitable for a remote and largely asynchronous work environment

Nice‑to‑haves

  • Proficient in writing idiomatic Go code, with solid understanding of the language’s core features such as interfaces, structs, composition, and error handling
  • Competent in profiling and performance tuning using Go’s built‑in tools such as pprof and trace, with a focus on optimisation
  • Demonstrated experience with event‑driven architectures, including the implementation of producers and consumers using platforms like Kafka, RabbitMQ, or ActiveMQ
  • Solid hands‑on experience deploying, monitoring, and maintaining applications on Kubernetes
  • Working knowledge of cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, GCP, Azure, Oracle Cloud) with experience deploying cloud‑native applications
  • Hands‑on experience with observability and monitoring tools like Prometheus and Grafana
  • Experience with MSML and SIP is a strong plus

Benefits

Why 1GLOBAL?

  • Growth Opportunities: Advance your career in one of the fastest growing telecommunications companies, expanding over 100% year‑on‑year under the leadership of successful tech entrepreneurs.
  • Major Transaction Exposure: Be in the driver’s seat for transactions that will have an impact on the future telco industry.
  • Work with a Talented Team: From the Board and the Founders to the Senior Management Team, you will collaborate daily with the most capable and renowned external advisors, and constantly being exposed to talented and driven individuals.
  • Dynamic Work Environment: Thrive in a collaborative, fast‑paced workplace where innovation is encouraged, and every contribution counts.
  • Professional Development: Work alongside industry experts to enhance your skills and knowledge in a cutting‑edge field.
  • International Experience: Gain opportunities to work in different 1GLOBAL offices around the world as you grow within the company.
  • Open Communication Culture: Join a team where your ideas are heard, and open dialogue is encouraged, fostering a supportive and transparent work environment.
  • Get Things Done Attitude: Be part of a results‑driven team that values efficiency, creativity, and the drive to make a tangible impact in the industry.

1GLOBAL is an equal opportunity employer, we value your character as much as your talent. Diversity drives our innovation, and we offer a collaborative, dynamic, and international work environment. We are excited for you to join our mission to revolutionise connectivity globally.

title: Principal Software Engineer - Credit Card Core Platforms
description:
Principal Software Engineer - Credit Card Core Platforms

Sr Staff Software Engineer - CC Core Platforms

About Nubank Nu is the world’s largest digital banking platform outside of Asia, serving over 123 million customers across Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia. The company has been leading an industry transformation by leveraging data and proprietary technology to develop innovative products and services. Guided by its mission to fight complexity and empower people, Nu caters to customers’ complete financial journey, promoting financial access and advancement with responsible lending and transparency. The company is powered by an efficient and scalable business model that combines low cost to serve with growing returns. Nu’s impact has been recognized in multiple awards, including Time 100 Companies, Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies, and Forbes World’s Best Banks. The Company is preparing for its next growth cycle where it will accelerate its internationalization process outside Latin America, and will also enter new verticals beyond financial services in its core markets taking advantage of the significant customer penetration.

About the role We are looking for a Senior Staff Software Engineer to lead the technical evolution of our Credit Card platform. This is not a traditional maintenance role. You will be the architect of a profound transformation: leveraging Generative AI to automate complex operational tasks and orchestrating the global migration from our current systems to a unified, future-proof architecture. You will be a key partner to the Engineering Leadership and a reference for the entire engineering community.

Mission Your goal is to design and operationalize a technical strategy that uses AI to increase operational efficiency while accelerating our global migration, ensuring:

  • Intelligent Maintenance: Implementing AI agents to analyze tickets and crashes, automating resolutions for the global credit card environment.
  • Seamless Migration: Leading the coexistence strategy between legacy and new platforms across Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia, ensuring data integrity and a flawless customer experience.
  • Technical Excellence: Solving deep architectural bottlenecks in high-scale distributed systems and raising the bar for software design globally.

Core Responsibilities

  • Migration Strategy: Define the long-term roadmap for decommissioning legacy systems, starting with the 1-year migration plan for the Colombian market.
  • AI-Driven Engineering: Architect and integrate AI solutions (cloud-based agents) to automate infrastructure maintenance and data migration.
  • Strategic Partnership: Collaborate with General Managers, PMs, and Staff+ ICs to align technical decisions with business needs across different countries.
  • Mentorship & Culture: Mentor senior engineers, fostering a culture of pragmatism, excellence in distributed systems, and the adoption of cutting-edge AI tools.
  • Navigating Complexity: You will work on high-scale systems supporting millions of transactions where every decision impacts customer limits and billing.
  • Modernizing the Core: You have the unique opportunity to make "legacy" systems attractive and efficient by applying AI to remove heavy operational toil.

Core Qualifications (What We’re Looking For)

  • Proven Track Record: 15+ years of experience in software engineering, with a focus on large-scale distributed systems.
  • Migration Mastery: Proven experience leading critical system migrations and managing coexistence between old and new architectures.
  • AI Fluency: A strong interest or practical experience in using GenAI/LLMs to solve engineering productivity and data analysis challenges.
  • Platform Mindset: Ability to design reusable APIs and contracts that serve multiple product teams with high reliability.
  • Global Communication: Fluent English is required to collaborate across our global hubs (Brazil, US, Mexico, and Colombia).

A posição atua no mercado brasileiro, caracterizado por um ambiente jurídico e regulatório complexo e em constante evolução. Atividades

Principais Atividades

A(o) funcionário(a) deverá desempenhar suas atividades em conformidade com o Sistema de Gestão de HSE, alinhado aos Princípios One Maestro e orientado à proteção da integridade das pessoas, tendo em vista a preservação do meio ambiente e dos recursos, contribuindo para a melhoria da eficiência energética e para a descarbonização dos ativos e da reputação da Companhia.

A posição de Especialista Jurídico Sênior é responsável por executar as seguintes atividades, com certo nível de autonomia, em alinhamento com as orientações do Gerente Jurídico e do Diretor de Jurídico, Assuntos Regulatórios e Governança Corporativa:

  1. Assessoria Jurídica Estratégica: Prestar assessoria jurídica e regulatória estratégica aos clientes internos, como equipes de Joint Ventures (JVs), em matérias administrativas, societárias, ambientais, cíveis, regulatórias de E&P e contenciosas.
  2. Elaboração e Negociação Contratual: Elaborar, revisar e negociar contratos comerciais, societários e operacionais relevantes, assegurando alinhamento com os modelos da TTE (quando aplicável), com os requisitos legais e com os objetivos do negócio.
  3. Suporte à Governança de JVs: Apoiar as joint ventures em processos de governança, identificando riscos jurídicos, propondo medidas de mitigação e garantindo a conformidade ao longo do ciclo de vida dos projetos.
  4. Relacionamento com Stakeholders e Autoridades: Atuar junto a partes externas, como autoridades governamentais, parceiros de joint ventures e associações do setor, apoiando o posicionamento jurídico da companhia e protegendo seus direitos e obrigações.
  5. Resolução de Conflitos: Recomendar e implementar estratégias e conduzir processos de resolução de disputas, incluindo arbitragens de alto valor, processos administrativos e judiciais, assegurando estratégia coerente, adequada avaliação de riscos e coordenação eficaz com escritórios externos.
  6. Monitoramento Legal e Regulatório e Avaliação de Impactos no Negócio: Monitorar evoluções legais e regulatórias que impactem as atividades de E&P e assessorar o negócio quanto a impactos, riscos e medidas de implementação necessárias.
  7. Coordenação de Escritórios Externos: Coordenar as atividades com escritórios de advocacia externos e especialistas, garantindo consistência estratégica e alto padrão de entregáveis.
  8. Representação e Atuação Institucional: Representar a companhia em comitês externos (ex.: IBP) e organizações do setor, liderando iniciativas de advocacy em matérias jurídicas e regulatórias e protegendo os ativos, a reputação e a licença social para operar no longo prazo.
  9. Reporte à Gestão: Reportar de forma consistente e buscar orientação da gestão em assuntos que envolvam elevada exposição financeira ou impacto reputacional.
  10. One Maestro: Atuar em conformidade com os princípios de HSSSE e One Maestro, visando proteger os ativos, a reputação e a licença de longo prazo para operar da companhia.

Responsabilidades

O Especialista Jurídico Sênior prestará suporte a outras divisões da TEPBR, conforme alocação definida pelo Gerente Jurídico e pelo Diretor de Jurídico, Assuntos Regulatórios e Governança Corporativa, bem como elaborará análises sobre temas regulatórios e jurídicos de média-alta complexidade e materialidade, relacionados a atividades, ativos e projetos especiais.

O cargo também apoiará a implementação e a observância das regras e regulamentos de Compliance e de HSE aplicáveis. Competências técnicas:

Experiência jurídica em nível sênior, com sólido conhecimento do arcabouço regulatório brasileiro e da prática internacional, especialmente em Leis do Petróleo e regulamentações da ANP. Experiência em estruturas contratuais sofisticadas de E&P é um diferencial, incluindo estruturas complexas de governança em múltiplos regimes jurídicos (PSC, Concessão), unitizações, redeterminações, bem como contratos de serviços técnicos (EPCIs e outros).

Competências comportamentais:

  • Comunicação: excelente comunicação verbal e habilidade de redação.
  • Influência e negociação: fortes habilidades de negociação e capacidade de influenciar diferentes stakeholders.
  • Autonomia e alinhamento: capacidade de atuar com bom nível de autonomia, mantendo alinhamento com a direção da gestão.
  • Priorização e entrega: habilidade para gerenciar alto volume de trabalho, priorizar de forma eficaz e entregar sob pressão de prazos.

  • Gestão de riscos e resolução de problemas: abordagem estruturada e estratégica para solução de problemas; definição e implementação de estratégias de mitigação de riscos.
  • Adaptabilidade: atualização constante frente à evolução das leis e regulamentos; desenvolvimento de soluções jurídicas e contratuais inovadoras para atender às necessidades da afiliada.

  • Ética: elevados padrões éticos.

Experiência profissional: mínimo de 10 anos de experiência jurídica, majoritariamente na indústria de Óleo e Gás (Upstream).

Diversidade e inclusão estão na pauta constante da MAG. Nos orgulhamos de ser uma companhia formada por mais de 80% de todos os nossos colaboradores pertencentes a, pelo menos, um grupo minorizado. Na MAG temos o forte propósito de oferecer soluções financeiras nos diversos momentos de vida de todos os brasileiros . Nos últimos três anos, realizamos o pagamento de mais de R$ 1 bilhão em benefícios a milhares de famílias. Dados como esse que nos levam a ser referência no mercado de Vida e Previdência, com quase 200 anos de atuação ininterrupta no Brasil.

Quer fazer parte dessa história? Conheça a nossa oportunidade.

Requisitos e qualificações

O que esperamos de você?

  • Ensino médio completo ou Ensino superior cursando/completo;

What will you be doing?

The Sales Operations Specialist is responsible for ensuring the sales organization operates with speed, accuracy, visibility, and accountability. This role owns the day‑to‑day execution and optimization of the sales tech stack—primarily HubSpot—so that Membership Directors (MDs), Setters, and Sales Leadership can focus on selling, not admin.

This is a hands‑on, systems‑focused role, not a people manager. You will work closely with Sales Leadership, Marketing, Fulfillment, and Data to maintain clean pipelines, automate workflows, enforce process discipline, and deliver reliable reporting.

At Decentralized Masters, Sales Ops is mission‑critical. This role directly impacts close rates, cash collection, forecasting accuracy, and the overall scalability of the revenue engine.

  • Pipeline value and velocity

  • Build and maintain sales dashboards for leadership.

Process Enforcement & Enablement

  • Act as the point person for Sales Ops requests, improvements, and bug fixes.

Compliance & Data Integrity

  • Maintain audit‑ready records for sales activity and deal history.
  • Partner with Security/IT on access control and data governance.

Requirements

What do you bring?

Required Experience

  • 2–5+ years in Sales Operations, RevOps, or CRM Administration
  • Hands‑on experience with HubSpot (required)
  • Strong background in sales automation and workflow design
  • Experience supporting high‑ticket or complex sales cycles preferred.

Skills & Attributes

  • Highly systems‑oriented and detail‑driven
  • Strong understanding of sales metrics and funnels
  • Comfortable working cross‑functionally with Sales, Marketing, Fulfillment, and Data
  • Proactive problem‑solver who spots issues before they become revenue problems
  • Clear communicator who can translate business needs into system logic

Bonus (Nice to Have)

  • Experience in high‑growth, remote‑first environments
  • Familiarity with Whop, aloware, or BI tools
  • Exposure to compliance‑heavy industries (finance, education, crypto, etc.)

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation
  • Remote‑first culture with a globally distributed team.
  • Opportunity to own the organic growth engine of a fast‑scaling DeFi brand.
  • Access to cutting‑edge tools, data, and creative freedom to innovate.
  • A values‑driven company culture that rewards results, autonomy, and excellence.

If you are ready to take on a challenge that will shape the future of crypto finance and grow with a team of innovators, we want to hear from you!

description:
ROC (Relay Operations Center) is the centralized command and control center for ‘Transportation Execution’ across the Amazon Supply Chain network supporting multiple geographies like NA, EU, India, Mexico, Brazil etc. It ensures hassle free, timely pick‑up and delivery of freight from vendors to Amazon fulfillment centers (FC) and from Amazon FCs to carrier hubs. In case of any exceptions, ROC steps in to resolve the issues by keeping the stakeholders informed on the proceedings. Along with tactical problem solving ROC is also charged with understanding trends in network exceptions and then automating processes or proposing process changes to streamline operations. This second aspect involves network monitoring and significant analysis of network data. Overall, ROC plays a critical role in ensuring the smooth functioning of Amazon transportation and thereby has a direct impact on Amazon’s ability to serve its customers on time.

Overview of a Transportation Specialist

A Transportation Specialist at ROC facilitates the flow of information between different stakeholders (Trans Carriers/Hubs/Warehouses) and resolves any potential issues that impact customer experience and business continuity. The role works across two verticals – Inbound and Outbound operations. Inbound Operations deals with Vendor/Carrier/FC relationships, ensuring that freight is picked‑up on time and delivered to FC as per the given appointment. Outbound Operations deals with FC/Carrier/Carrier Hub relationships, ensuring that the truck leaves the FC to deliver customer orders as per promise. A Transportation Specialist provides timely resolution by researching and querying internal tools, taking real‑time decisions, analyzing data, noticing trends, and driving customer experience without compromising on time. The ideal candidate should understand basic logistics, communicate clearly in written and oral form, ideate process improvements, and drive them to completion.

title: Research Assistant
description:
The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission. At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.

Here Is What We Offer

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Basic Function

Howard University is currently seeking a highly motivated and organized Research Assistant to work on a federally funded research study related to COVID-19. The Research Assistants will be primarily responsible for recruiting potential adult participants at Howard University Hospital in Washington DC and the neighboring communities. Participants to be enrolled for the study are past COVID-19 patients. The study seeks to assess Long COVID prevalence and associated risk factors.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Screen electronic medical records to identify eligible study participants, contact potential participants in a timely manner.
  • Obtain informed consent in accordance with research protocols, procedures, and good clinical practice guidelines.
  • Administer survey assessments and enter data in REDCap.
  • Perform and document risk assessments.
  • Attend mandatory study specific trainings and team meetings.
  • Complete and file daily paperwork accurately and in a timely manner.
  • Organize and maintain study participants’ data and extract medical data as needed.
  • Document accurate encounters and shift events, adhere to all study procedures, and communicate daily/weekly updates to study coordinator and recruitment lead.
  • Assist the follow-up team in preparing participants’ scheduling and completing follow-up visits virtually and in person.
  • Other duties deemed necessary to maintain smooth operations of the research program such as biospecimen preparation, packaging and mailing to the biorepository core.

Core Competencies

As a critical component to the success of the study, the primary responsibility of the Research Assistants will be patients’ engagement, community outreach, and participants’ enrollment in the study. Personable, detail-oriented, flexible with scheduling, able to work independently and as part of a team.

Minimum Requirements

Bachelor’s degree in Sciences, Public Health or health-related fields.

Previous research experience, clinic/hospital work or volunteer experience, and knowledge of the research process is preferred. This position requires flexibility and availability to adapt to patients’ schedules. Reliable transportation is necessary to complete participants’ interviews at various community locations. Spanish language is a plus.

Compliance Salary Range Disclosure

$40,000-$50,000

title: Quais Empresas De Ônibus No RJ Estão Contratando Motorista
description:
✅ Empresas de ônibus como Viação Redentor, Real Auto Ônibus e Transportes Flores estão contratando motoristas no RJ.

Atualmente, várias empresas de ônibus no Rio de Janeiro estão com processos seletivos abertos para a contratação de motoristas. Essas oportunidades são frequentes devido à alta demanda por profissionais capacitados para atuar no transporte público, sobretudo em grandes centros urbanos como o RJ. Entre as empresas que estão contratando, destacam-se companhias que operam linhas municipais, intermunicipais e interestaduais, oferecendo vagas que normalmente exigem CNH categoria D ou E, além de experiência comprovada.

Este artigo detalha quais são as principais empresas de ônibus no Rio de Janeiro que estão contratando motoristas atualmente, explicando os requisitos básicos para se candidatar, as formas de inscrição e os benefícios que essas empresas costumam oferecer. Além disso, abordamos dicas importantes para quem deseja ingressar nessa área, incluindo informações sobre o mercado de trabalho, a demanda por motoristas e os cuidados para escolher a vaga ideal.

Empresas de ônibus no RJ com vagas abertas para motoristas

  • Viação 1001 – Atua nas linhas interestaduais e intermunicipais, frequentemente buscando motoristas com experiência e CNH categoria D ou E.
  • Viação São Silvestre – Opera linhas municipais em vários bairros do RJ e costuma abrir vagas para motoristas, principalmente em períodos de alta demanda.
  • Auto Viação Jabour – Empresa tradicional no transporte público urbano do RJ, que em algumas épocas contrata profissionais para reforço em suas operações.
  • Viação Novo Rio – Especializada em linhas urbanas e rodoviárias, frequentemente disponibiliza vagas para motoristas qualificados.
  • Viação Redentor – Conhecida pelo transporte intermunicipal, mantém processos seletivos regulares para motoristas profissionais.

Requisitos legais e habilitação

Antes de mais nada, o candidato precisa possuir Carteira Nacional de Habilitação (CNH) na categoria D ou E , que permite a condução de veículos com mais de 8 passageiros . Além disso, a Certificação de Curso MOPP (Movimentação Operacional de Produtos Perigosos) pode ser exigida por algumas empresas, especialmente para linhas que eventualmente transportem cargas específicas.

  • CNH categoria D ou E válida e regularizada;
  • Comprovante de residência atualizado;
  • Certificado do curso MOPP (quando aplicável);
  • Atestado de saúde ocupacional para garantir aptidão física e mental;
  • Currículo atualizado com experiência comprovada na função.

Requisitos comuns para motoristas de ônibus no RJ

  • CNH categoria D ou E: obrigatória para condução de veículos de transporte coletivo.
  • Experiência comprovada: muitas empresas exigem no mínimo 1 a 2 anos de experiência como motorista de ônibus.
  • Curso de Transporte Coletivo: certificado pelo DETRAN, necessário para alguns processos seletivos.
  • Exame médico e psicológico: para garantir a aptidão física e mental do candidato.
  • Disponibilidade de horário: Muitas vagas exigem trabalho em turnos, finais de semana e feriados.

Competências Comportamentais e Técnicas

  • Responsabilidade e atenção redobrada ao trafegar em vias urbanas e rodoviárias sob condições variadas;
  • Boa comunicação para lidar com passageiros e equipe;
  • Conhecimento das rotas e pontos turísticos do RJ;
  • Capacidade de resolução rápida de problemas e situações de emergência;
  • Resistência física para longas jornadas de trabalho.

Benefícios comuns oferecidos para motoristas de ônibus no RJ

  • Vale-transporte, vale-refeição, assistência médica e planos de carreira são comuns nas empresas do setor.

Média salarial para motoristas de ônibus no Rio de Janeiro

A média varia entre R$ 1.800 a R$ 3.000, dependendo da empresa, turno e benefícios oferecidos.

Pontos-chave sobre Contratação de Motoristas de Ônibus no RJ

  • Empresas principais: Viação 1001, Viação Penha, Auto Viação Redentor, Viação Sul Fluminense.
  • Requisitos: CNH D, experiência anterior, curso especializado em transporte coletivo.
  • Salário médio: R$ 1.800 a R$ 3.000 mensais, com benefícios inclusos.
  • Onde buscar vagas: Sites oficiais, plataformas de emprego (InfoJobs, Indeed, LinkedIn).
  • Processo seletivo: Pode incluir testes práticos, entrevistas e análise de documentação.
  • Benefícios comuns: Vale-transporte, vale-refeição, assistência médica, seguro de vida.
  • Mercado: Alta demanda por motoristas qualificados devido ao transporte coletivo urbano no RJ.

Projetando o futuro. Transformando o mundo.

O negócio de consultoria da Wood é composto por 4.000 dos maiores especialistas técnicos e de domínio profundo do mundo, especialistas em engenharia e cientistas industriais, focados em aconselhar e implementar soluções que geram valor real para nossos clientes em qualquer estágio do ciclo de vida do ativo.

O que podemos oferecer

  • Projetos significativos e interessantes entregues a líderes da indústria.
  • Arranjos de trabalho flexíveis que equilibram as necessidades do cliente, da equipe e individuais. Esta oportunidade é híbrida en Rio de Janeiro, RJ.

Em nosso processo de contratação, estendemos nossas oportunidades a pessoas com deficiência (PCD), promovendo um ambiente inclusivo e acessível para todos.

Na Wood, estamos comprometidos com oportunidades iguais e convidamos todos os indivíduos talentosos a considerar se juntar à nossa equipe. Será necessário que todos nós trabalhemos juntos para entregar soluções aos desafios mais críticos do mundo.

  • Elaborar propostas técnicas para projetos subsea, estimar recursos e horas-homem necessárias para entregar um determinado escopo e apoiar a equipe local de Crescimento e Desenvolvimento na prospecção de novos clientes e projetos

  • Apoiar o desenvolvimento de procedimentos operacionais em todas as etapas do trabalho
  • Gestão e administração de projetos
  • Facilitar a comunicação entre as equipes de Consultoria de Houston e do Rio de Janeiro
  • Reporte funcional ao Gerente da Equipe de Gerenciamento de Projetos (Houston, TX) e localmente ao Gerente de Consultoria (Brasil)

  • Sólida experiência técnica

  • Compreensão demonstrada dos direcionadores de negócios, da indústria e dos clientes
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação (oral e escrita) e relacionamento interpessoal
  • Capacidade de engajar diversos stakeholders e liderar equipes
  • Excelente gestão do tempo e capacidade de priorização, equilibrando as necessidades de múltiplas partes interessadas

Desejável:

Nosso compromisso é humanizar as relações, respeitando à individualidade e garantindo que cada colaborador sinta-se valorizado, incluído e parte essencial de nossa comunidade.

Somos uma fintech em crescimento acelerado que está protagonizando a evolução do financiamento imobiliário . O desafio

Buscamos um Senior Data Engineer para liderar a construção da engenharia de dados da Volpi desde a base.

Hoje, nossos dados estão distribuídos em múltiplas fontes, com diferentes níveis de maturidade. Seu papel será estruturar essa fundação: definir a arquitetura, organizar os dados, criar pipelines confiáveis e habilitar a criação de produtos de dados que apoiem decisões críticas de negócio.

O que você vai fazer:

  • Desenhar, implementar e evoluir a arquitetura de dados da Volpi , com foco em um modelo de lakehouse na AWS;
  • Estruturar pipelines de ingestão, transformação e consumo de dados (batch e, futuramente, streaming);
  • Trabalhar com dados sensíveis de crédito e pessoas, seguindo padrões rigorosos de segurança, governança e compliance ;
  • Lidar com dados distribuídos em múltiplos silos , conectando fontes e criando visões mais maduras para o negócio;
  • Atender demandas estratégicas de diferentes áreas (crédito, operações, produto, engenharia);
  • Organizar e evoluir o data lake existente (já temos estrutura inicial em AWS, Athena e S3);
  • Criar a base para produtos de dados futuros , incluindo análises avançadas de crédito e soluções orientadas a dados;
  • Atuar de forma full-cycle, da concepção técnica à implementação, operação e evolução em produção.

O que esperamos de você:

  • Experiência sólida como Data Engineer , com forte mentalidade de engenharia (Data Engineer aqui é dev);
  • Domínio de Python e SQL para construção de pipelines e soluções de dados em produção;
  • Experiência prática com AWS , especialmente serviços como S3, Athena e IAM;
  • Conhecimento e uso de Infraestrutura como Código (IaC) ;
  • Vivência com pipelines de dados em produção, lidando com volumes relevantes e dados sensíveis;
  • Forte preocupação com segurança da informação , padrões de projeto e boas práticas de engenharia;
  • Experiência em ambientes de startup , lidando com pouco legado e muita construção do zero;
  • Autonomia para tomar decisões técnicas e conduzir projetos end-to-end;
  • Capacidade de traduzir necessidades de negócio em soluções de dados escaláveis;
  • Comunicação clara e estruturada, especialmente em ambientes assíncronos.

Será considerado um diferencial:

  • Experiência com arquiteturas de dados modernas, como lakehouse;
  • Uso de ferramentas de orquestração e transformação de dados (ex: Airflow, dbt ou similares);
  • Atuação em domínios complexos e regulados, como financeiro, crédito ou seguros;

Um vendedor de loja desempenha um papel crucial em garantir que os clientes tenham uma experiência de compra satisfatória e eficiente.

As principais responsabilidades de um vendedor incluem:

  • Atendimento ao Cliente: Receber e saudar os clientes, oferecer assistência na escolha de produtos, responder a perguntas e fornecer informações detalhadas sobre itens e promoções.
  • Apresentação e Demonstração de Produtos: Mostrar produtos aos clientes, explicar suas características e benefícios, e fazer recomendações com base nas necessidades e preferências dos clientes.
  • Processamento de Vendas: Ajudar no processo de checkout, que pode incluir operar a caixa registradora ou sistema de ponto de venda (PDV), embalar produtos e realizar transações de pagamento.
  • Gestão de Estoque: Monitorar níveis de estoque, reabastecer prateleiras e expositores, e garantir que os produtos estejam sempre disponíveis e bem apresentados.
  • Organização da Loja: Manter a loja limpa e organizada, rearranjar produtos e garantir que a área de vendas esteja sempre atraente e acessível para os clientes.
  • Promoções e Ofertas: Informar os clientes sobre promoções e ofertas especiais, e incentivá-los a aproveitar essas oportunidades.
  • Resolução de Problemas: Lidar com reclamações e problemas dos clientes de maneira eficiente e profissional, buscando soluções que atendam às necessidades dos clientes e mantenham a boa reputação da loja.
  • Atingir Metas de Vendas: Trabalhar para atingir ou superar as metas de vendas estabelecidas pela loja, usando técnicas de vendas e estratégias para maximizar as oportunidades.
  • Atualização e Treinamento: Manter-se atualizado sobre os produtos, tendências de mercado e políticas da loja, participando de treinamentos e reuniões conforme necessário.
  • Feedback e Melhoria Contínua: Fornecer feedback à gerência sobre as necessidades dos clientes e quaisquer problemas que possam impactar a experiência de compra, contribuindo para melhorias contínuas na operação da loja.

Essas responsabilidades ajudam a criar uma experiência de compra positiva, aumentar as vendas e fortalecer o relacionamento com os clientes, o que é essencial para o sucesso de nossas lojas.

Diversidade e inclusão estão na pauta constante da MAG. Nos orgulhamos de ser uma companhia formada por mais de 80% de todos os nossos colaboradores pertencentes a, pelo menos, um grupo minorizado. Descrição

Vita Check-up

Sobre a vaga: Buscamos uma Técnica de Patologia qualificada, dedicada e com boa comunicação para integrar nossa equipe multidisciplinar. Você será responsável por promover o encantamento do cliente por meio da condução segura, humanizada e eficiente dos processos de assistência, coleta de exames laboratoriais, preparo e envio de amostras, avaliações de bioimpedância e demais procedimentos de preparo para o check‑up. Atuar na prevenção e solução de intercorrências, assegurando excelência na experiência do cliente, mantendo a liderança informada e solicitando providências quando necessário. Prestar assistência às necessidades básicas dos clientes (higiene, conforto e apoio emocional), zelando continuamente por sua segurança e bem‑estício durante toda a jornada no serviço.

Principais responsabilidades

  • Realizar coleta de exames laboratoriais, incluindo punção venosa para coleta de sangue, seguindo protocolos técnicos e de biossegurança.
  • Executar avaliações de bioimpedância e outros procedimentos de preparo dos clientes para exames.
  • Preparar amostras biológicas para envio à análise técnica, incluindo identificação, centrifugação, acondicionamento, armazenamento e rastreabilidade.
  • Cadastrar informações de exames nos sistemas laboratoriais, de imagem e demais avaliações, garantindo fluxo ágil e seguro de atendimento.
  • Acompanhar e prestar apoio aos clientes durante a realização do check‑up, oferecendo orientações e suporte sempre que necessário.
  • Organizar salas de atendimento, conferindo formulários, equipamentos e materiais, inclusive controle de validade.
  • Avaliar necessidade de materiais permanentes (ex.: braçadeira de PNI, cabos, sensores) e descartáveis, solicitando reposição e preenchendo check‑lists.
  • Executar limpeza, desinfecção e esterilização de equipamentos e superfícies, conforme protocolos institucionais.
  • Zelar pelo uso adequado e conservação dos equipamentos, comunicando anormalidades à liderança imediata.
  • Cumprir estratégias e diretrizes da Diretoria, participando de reuniões e rituais de gestão quando solicitado.

Competências funcionais e técnicas

  • Conhecimento e experiência em coleta de sangue e demais exames laboratoriais.
  • Domínio dos processos de preparo de amostras biológicas (centrifugação, identificação, acondicionamento e envio).
  • Conhecimento de biossegurança e uso adequado de EPIs conforme NR‑32.
  • Noções de atendimento humanizado ao cliente em ambiente de saúde.
  • Capacidade de registro correto de informações em sistemas.
  • Capacidade de se expressar corretamente verbal e na escrita.

Competências comportamentais

  • Comunicação e capacidade para lidar com conflitos: Habilidade de construir e manter relacionamentos dentro e fora do setor Operacional. Clareza oral e escrita, capacidade de expressar suas ideias. Capacidade para ouvir e entender a necessidade dos clientes externos e internos das demais áreas do negócio.

  • Trabalho em equipe: trabalha cooperativamente, integrando pessoas e gerando uma ambiência de trabalho produtivo e colaborativo.
  • Adaptação à mudança: entendimento e capacidade de ajustar às prioridades, direcionamentos e conjuntura. Flexibilidade para mudança de acordo com o ambiente. Habilidade para reconhecer problemas e propor soluções.

Job Description

The position

The FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 Accessibility Manager working alongside the FIFA Zurich Human Rights and Anti-Discrimination team and reporting to the Head of Sustainability is responsible for supporting the successful development and implementation of the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ with a particular focus on accessibility and inclusivity.

This position plays an integral part in ensuring a successful Tournament through the implementation of accessible infrastructure and services.

As the Tournament draws closer, this role will evolve from planning into operations resulting in an assignment to a competition or non-competition location for the Tournament period.

Key responsibilities

Manage the delivery of key Sustainability & Human Rights Strategy initiatives to

  • Ensure an accessible FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ for disabled people and people with limited mobility, including:
  • Auditing of official FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ sites against FIFA’s accessibility requirements.
  • Ensuring improvements to fulfil those requirements are implemented.
  • Working with multiple functional areas and stakeholders to ensure accessible services and guidance are delivered for participants, attendees and workforce.
  • Developing and delivering accessibility training and awareness raising for key functional areas and stakeholders.

Liaise with and/or support host cities and other organisations in Brazil or functional areas in their delivery of initiatives that

  • Facilitate accessibility for disabled people and people with limited mobility across physical infrastructure, public transport and services in Brazil.
  • Build local accessibility expertise to deliver the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ and foster the development of the sports and events industries in the region.
  • Empower people in the region through football programmes and the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ platform.

As a member of the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ Sustainability & Human Rights Team

  • Design and implement sustainable procurement practices that facilitate a welcoming and accessible tournament experience for participants, attendees and workforce.
  • Work closely with FIFA Human Rights & Anti-Discrimination staff based in Zurich and relevant teams within the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ entity to deliver jointly managed projects and activities.
  • Assist the planning and coordination of meetings, workshops and site visits.

Your profile

  • A deep passion for sustainability and inclusivity, driven to leveraging the unique value of mega-sporting events to contribute to sustainable development goals and the promotion of responsible business practices;

  • 5 years of work experience implementing accessibility programmes;
  • Experience of working in a comparable role in an international, fast-paced environment, complex project, preferably in the events and/or sports industry;
  • Proven track record of generating productive stakeholder relationships that successfully deliver sustainability/social responsibility outcomes;
  • Demonstrated ability in event planning and event project management, prioritize effectively, and work independently.
  • Proficiency in written and verbal English communication; and
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) planning software and online collaboration tools.

Candidates with experience in the following areas will have an advantage

  • University degree in social sciences, human rights, equality, diversity and/or international relations;

Unique knowledge and skills

The Problems You’ll Solve

At Carta, our employees set out on a mission to unlock the power of equity ownership for more people in more places. We believe that the problems we solve today unlock the opportunities of tomorrow.

The Technical Implementation Specialist is responsible for bridging the gap between our core LPPA extraction tool engine and our clients’ downstream internal systems. You are essentially the “Last Mile” problem solver. While our platform excels at turning unstructured investment documents into structured data, our clients cannot realize the full value of that data if it doesn't “talk” to their existing downstream systems (like eFront, Investran, or internal ERPs).

You will be responsible for solving the “Last Mile” delivery problem—ensuring that the data we extract is not just accurate, but immediately actionable within the client’s unique technical ecosystem. This involves navigating complex data mapping, managing secure connectivity across diverse IT infrastructures, and acting as the go‑to for delivering bespoke integration solutions in the template the client needs under tight deadlines.

The team's core mission is to solve the “Last Mile” problem in data delivery and utilization, specifically focusing on custom integration. Our platform excels at transforming unstructured investment documents into structured data. However, this data only achieves its full value when it seamlessly integrates with a client's existing downstream systems (such as eFront, Investran, or internal ERPs). The Custom Integration Lead acts as the crucial bridge between our core data extraction engine and these client‑specific systems. This role is responsible for ensuring the extracted data is immediately actionable within the client’s unique technical environment.

This Involves

  • Act as the primary technical point of contact for new clients requiring custom delivery solutions.

  • Act as the first line of defense for production issues: perform initial triage and investigation of reported bugs.

The Team You’ll Work With

You’ll be joining our Custom Integrations Team, a specialized engineering and delivery pod within the broader R&D and Implementation/delivery teams. Our team is the critical link between our core LPPA engine and the production environments of the world’s leading Limited Partners (LPs). We are a high‑impact, agile unit consisting of a Lead, a Tech Lead, and Developers, dedicated to architecting bespoke data transformation and delivery solutions. By ensuring our data integrates seamlessly into diverse downstream systems, we directly enable our clients to achieve real‑time visibility into their private market investments. Our work is the final, essential step in the value chain, turning raw extracted data into a functional, automated asset for our customers.

  • Technical Liaison. You act as the primary technical point of contact for new clients, translating complex downstream system requirements into comprehensive Functional and Technical Specification files.

title: Operations Intern
description:
Job Function:

Employment Type: Fixed Term

Yinson is a dynamic, equal opportunity employer with great organisational culture where people are valued and empowered to deliverpowerful solutions.

About Yinson

Yinson is a leading global integrated offshore production company committed to fostering innovation and sustainability. We pride ourselves on a culture that values teamwork, excellence, and proactive problem‑solving, ensuring that every team member contributes to a sustainable future. Our vision is to become a world‑class provider of integrated energy solutions, and your role as an intern will play a significant part in this journey.

Core Responsibilities

  • Assist the Onshore Team in monitoring and controlling daily operations, ensuring compliance with company standards and contributing to overall operational efficiency.
  • Manage communication with subcontractors and suppliers, ensuring timely and quality delivery of services and materials to bolster operational success.
  • Collaborate with various departments to meet both vessel and global demands, aiding in the enhancement of interdepartmental synergy and response capabilities.
  • Participate in workshops focused on Health, Safety, and Environment (HSE) practices, including Task Risk Analysis and Critical Analysis, to heighten safety awareness and operational readiness.
  • Engage in client meetings to understand contracts and operational responsibilities, enhancing your educational experience.
  • Support the operations interface, promoting seamless interactions across all onshore and offshore departments.

Duties

  • Assist the Onshore Team in maintaining the Operations Management System and the Computerized Maintenance Management System, ensuring data integrity and accessibility.
  • Review and update procedures, work instructions, and job descriptions, aligning them with best practices and regulatory requirements.
  • Draft documentation for Purchasing Order/Contract issuance, including Scopes of Work and Technical Analyses.
  • Participate in audits and inspections to assess the compliance and effectiveness of operational processes.
  • Monitor and document the status of material embarkation and disembarkation as well as third‑party mobilisations and payments, relaying essential updates to the team.
  • All internship activities will be conducted onshore; please note the intern will not embark offshore.
  • Engage in quarterly feedback sessions with your supervisor to discuss performance, challenges, and growth opportunities.
  • By the end of the internship, you will be well‑versed in articulating the fundamentals of oil, gas, and water topsides, as well as marine processes related to cargo storage, handling, and offloading.

Health, Safety, and Environment (HSE) Responsibilities

  • Maintain a keen awareness of health and safety practices, proactively observing and reporting any unsafe activities, conditions, or situations.
  • Utilise the 'Stop Work' policy whenever unsafe conditions are noted, prioritising safety in all operational undertakings.

Qualifications

  • Mandatory: Currently pursuing an undergraduate degree in engineering, with a commitment to a two-year internship.
  • Desirable: Coursework in technical subjects related to operations or engineering.

Skills & Experiences

  • Mandatory: Basic understanding of English and proficiency in MS Office applications.

Responsável pela operação e a manutenção da infraestrutura dos prédios industriais e data center.

Principais atividades

  • Gerenciar a rotina de operação dos Prédios Industriais (Centrais e Datacenters) com ênfase na manutenção preventiva, preditiva e corretiva de equipamentos de infraestrutura, definindo procedimentos de atuação, padrões de qualidade e confiabilidade da planta;
  • Coordenar equipes multidisciplinares, fornecedores e empresas de manutenção, interagindo como suporte na correção emergencial de falhas e no controle das atividades programadas, bem como no acompanhamento do SLA e KPI dos contratos da área;

  • Identificar vulnerabilidades da infraestrutura crítica e propor planos de mitigação para garantir continuidade dos serviços;

  • Monitorar utilização de sistemas BMS/DCIM para análise de alarmes, tendências e antecipação de falhas;
  • Coordenar processos de Change Management para intervenções em ambientes críticos, minimizando riscos de indisponibilidade;
  • Avaliar e propor novas soluções de automação, IoT e inteligência artificial aplicadas à manutenção preditiva e preventiva;
  • Desenvolver programas estruturados de capacitação técnica para equipes próprias e terceirizadas;
  • Liderar planos de resposta a incidentes críticos, assegurando comunicação clara e tomada de decisão rápida.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Superior completo - preferencialmente engenharias mecânicas, civil e Telecom;
  • Experiência em operação e manutenção de infraestrutura crítica em ambientes de telecomunicações, TI e data centers (Telcos e Enterprise), incluindo fornecedores de equipamentos de missão crítica;
  • Experiência em gestão de equipes multidisciplinares e fornecedores, com atuação em plantão e resposta rápida a incidentes de alta severidade;
  • Inglês intermediário/avançado para leitura de manuais técnicos, interação com fornecedores internacionais e elaboração de relatórios;
  • Experiência em rotinas de manutenção de sistemas elétricos em corrente alternada (CA): geração de energia, interpretação de projetos, dimensionamento de demanda e operação de equipamentos como Centro de Medição, Cabine de Alta Tensão, Quadros de Distribuição, GMG, USCA e Inversores;
  • Domínio em sistemas de corrente contínua (CC): operação de FCC, NoBreaks e bancos de baterias, assegurando redundância e continuidade de energia;
  • Experiência em dimensionamento e projeto de sistemas elétricos de potência, proteção e seletividade em Média e Baixa Tensão (CA e CC);
  • Conhecimento em sistemas de proteção contra descargas atmosféricas (SPDA) e avaliação de conformidade;
  • Experiência em operação e dimensionamento de sistemas de climatização (PLC, Split, Self Contained, Fancoil, Chiller), garantindo eficiência térmica em ambientes críticos;
  • Conhecimento em automação predial e protocolos de comunicação (BMS, redes de monitoramento), com capacidade de análise de alarmes e tendências;
  • Aplicação prática das normas técnicas e regulatórias (NR, NBR, ANSI, TIA, ASHRAE), assegurando compliance e segurança operacional;
  • Domínio de ferramentas de visualização e análise de dados (Power BI, Excel avançado - fórmulas, vlookup, tabelas dinâmicas), para relatórios e planos de ação;
  • Experiência em gestão de orçamento, com foco em otimização de custos e eficiência operacional;
  • Conhecimento técnico em redes de telecomunicações, integrando infraestrutura elétrica e lógica;
  • Experiência em elaboração e aprovação de MOPs (Method of Procedure) e acompanhamento de atividades críticas em ambientes industriais e data centers;
  • Histórico de participação em projetos de automação e inovação tecnológica, aplicando IoT e soluções digitais para manutenção preditiva;
  • Conhecimentos desejáveis em metodologias Agile, Scrum e Lean Six Sigma, aplicados à melhoria contínua de processos de manutenção e operação.

description:
Somos a Âmbar, a empresa de geração e comercialização de energia do grupo J&F, o maior grupo privado do Brasil. Nosso amplo portfólio de ativos contribui para a expansão e diversificação da matriz energética do Brasil.

Temos 50 unidades de geração de energia, essenciais para a segurança no abastecimento de eletricidade. Nossas usinas fortalecem a transição energética sustentável para o país e para os nossos clientes. Somos o quarto maior gerador de energia a gás natural do Brasil em capacidade instalada. Possuímos ainda unidades hidrelétricas, solares, a biomassa, a carvão mineral e o biogás.

title: Software Maintenance Engineer
description:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world’s leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office‑based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder‑led, profitable, and growing.

We are hiring a Software Maintenance Engineer to work in a dynamic and exciting engineering role in Linux‑based infrastructure and applications. You will cover all layers of the stack, including bare metal, virtualization (KVM), containerization (Docker/LXC/LXD), storage (Ceph and Linux file systems), networking (OVS, OVN and Core networking), OpenStack, Kubernetes and the open source applications running on top of them. It will challenge you to show the breadth of your engineering skills, which will be needed to work on almost any aspect of Ubuntu and the open source applications large enterprise customers run.

This role deals with critical issues in the open source stack that require upstream bug fixes. Our engineers are able to work productively at any level of the stack including the kernel and in a wide range of languages, to understand and address the software issues at hand. Our group is critical to the success of our customers, partners and Ubuntu itself. You will help with troubleshooting and driving issues to resolution with workarounds, guidance, and bug fixes to be released upstream and in Ubuntu.

Location: This is a remote role, we have teams in all time zones.

The role entails

  • Resolve complex customer problems related to Ubuntu, Kernel, Ceph, OpenStack, or Kubernetes and other open source software
  • Maintain a close working relationship with Canonical’s Field, Support and product engineering teams
  • Participate in upstream communities
  • Develop bug fixes, backport patches, and work with upstream for inclusion
  • Review code produced by other engineers
  • Demonstrate good judgment in technical methods and techniques
  • Prioritize work and manage your time effectively against those priorities
  • Participate in team discussions to improve processes, tools, and documentation
  • Maintain clear, technical and concise communications
  • Work from home and travel internationally up to 10% of work time for team meetings, events and conferences

What we are looking for in you

  • An exceptional academic track record
  • Background in Computer Science, STEM or similar
  • Experience with Linux and open source software
  • Experience with at least one of Python, Go, C or C++ on Linux
  • A drive to learn unfamiliar technology and deep‑dive difficult issues
  • Willingness to travel up to 4 times a year for internal events

Nice‑to‑have skills

  • You love technology and working with brilliant people
  • You are curious, flexible, articulate, and accountable
  • You value soft skills and are passionate, enterprising, thoughtful, and self‑motivated
  • You have interest in, or willingness to learn about, any of the following: Ubuntu Linux – kernel or userspace, Kubernetes, OpenStack, Ceph, QEMU/KVM, LXC/LXD, PostgreSQL, Mongo, Debian packaging, distributed systems

What we offer colleagues

  • Distributed work environment with twice‑yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long‑haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open‑source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer. We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

title: Corporate Communications Senior Manager FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027TM
description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (FWWC2027). Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Job Description

The position The Corporate Communications Senior Manager will lead strategic planning and delivery of communications and public relations strategies and activities for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™, ensuring the tournament is powerfully positioned in line with FIFA’s overall strategic objectives and the FIFA Women’s Football Strategy.

This role is responsible to support the Head of Communications & Media Relations in the rollout and implementation of the Communications components of the tournament’s Marketing & Communications Strategy, with a strong focus on Brazil and South America. The position plays a central role in leading the development and implementation of proactive corporate communications that enhance FIFA’s reputation, raise awareness on the tournament, influence public perception, engage with internal and external stakeholders for higher impact and ensures consistency across proactive and reactive messaging at a global level.

Reporting jointly to the Head of Communications & Media Relations based in Brazil and to the Team Lead Corporate Communications in Switzerland, the Corporate Communications Senior Manager collaborates with senior stakeholders, decision-makers, and leadership teams to translate corporate priorities and tournament objectives into engaging, credible narratives.

Key responsibilities

  • Lead and implement a corporate communications-first approach, delivering proactive, strategic messaging and storytelling across Brazil and South America in line with the Marketing & Communications Strategy.
  • Develop messaging for tournament milestones, events, initiatives, campaigns, announcements and key FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ functional areas.
  • Act as the central integrator for communications-related matters, coordinating internal and external stakeholders including FIFA27 functional teams, Host City communications teams, federal, state and municipal authorities, the CBF, and other key partners.
  • Develop and implement pre-emptive communications plans to manage risk, address sensitive topics and engage targeted audiences.
  • Develop issues and crisis communications planning and execution within FIFA27 in close alignment with the FIFA Communications Division, supporting all relevant partners and activities in the lead-up to and during the tournament.
  • Build close working relationships with other Marketing and Communications teams to ensure narrative unity and operational efficiency.
  • Partner with the Media Relations department to identify and amplify proactive stories that shape public understanding of FIFA’s initiatives.
  • Partner with digital, editorial, and campaign teams to deliver integrated storytelling across FIFA’s ecosystem.
  • Perform other duties directly related to the role, as required by FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ leadership or the FIFA Communications Division.

Your profile

  • Minimum 7 years experience in communications, media and public relations, with experience in similar leadership positions
  • Familiarity with the world of football. Passion for women’s football is a plus
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written) and Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Spanish language skills are an asset
  • Able and willing to travel up to 50% of the year
  • Able and willing to work non-traditional hours including evenings and weekends as needed
  • Ability to relocate to Rio de Janeiro.

About FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027

The FIFA Women’s World Cup™ is the greatest women’s sporting event on the planet, showcasing the best players in the world on the biggest stage. In 2027, history will be made as Brazil welcomes the tournament to South America for the first time ever.

This landmark event will unite the world through an unprecedented celebration of women’s football, inspiring billions of fans across the globe. As we prepare to host teams and supporters from every corner of the world, we’re looking for passionate, talented individuals to be part of history and help deliver an unforgettable tournament.

Join us and play your role in making FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ a truly extraordinary experience that celebrates and elevates women’s football.

  • Coordenar com o time de digital os conteúdos que serão aproveitados em redes sociais, cortes, chamadas e interações ao vivo.
  • Participar ativamente de reuniões com outras áreas envolvidas nos eventos.

  • Garantir que todas as entregas comerciais e ativações de marca estejam previstas no espelho (citadas, GC, vinhetas, quadros patrocinados, "golden breaks", chamadas, integrações com digital etc.).

  • Sugerir formatos de ativações que equilibrem qualidade editorial, experiência da audiência e resultado comercial.

  • Assegurar que a linguagem, o tom e o formato das transmissões estejam alinhados a estratégia da marca e as características de cada plataforma (TV, streaming, YouTube, redes sociais).
  • Garantir o cumprimento de diretrizes de direitos de transmissão, uso de imagem, política das ligas/federação e normas internas da empresa.
  • Apoiar a direção na priorização de pautas, escolha de quadros e ajustes da narrativa ao longo da transmissão.

6. Pós-Transmissão e Melhoria Contínua

  • Participar e/ou conduzir o debrief das transmissões, identificando acertos, falhas e oportunidades de melhoria.
  • Consolidar relatórios qualitativos e, quando aplicável, quantitativos (execução de entregas, problemas técnicos, feedback de audiência e repercussão digital).
  • Manter histórico de espelhos, roteiros, formatos e boas práticas, servindo como base para evolução dos produtos.

Qualification & Experiencie:

  • Experiência em produção e coordenação de transmissões ao vivo, preferencialmente no universo esportivo.

title: Sales Analyst
description:
Overview


FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.


Department and Location


Department: Partnerships & Media


Location: Brazil


The Position


The Sales Analyst will support the sponsorship sales team with research, analysis and data on potential sponsors. She/He will be responsible for generating research reports, data sets, market/category/brand specific insights and sales materials as well as the management of the Business Development Directory.


She/He will also be responsible for supporting the sales team in building compelling sales presentations utilising a range of internal and external data and partner case-studies. A key role in supporting sponsorship sales and strategic partnerships for the FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™, with a strong focus on the Brazilian and LATAM markets.


The role requires deep market knowledge, a robust network in the region, and the ability to communicate fluently in English and Portuguese. Spanish is considered a plus.


Key Responsibilities



  • Work closely with the Head of Partnership Sales, FIFA Women’s World Cup Sales Lead and the broader commercial team to deliver on sponsorship sales objectives for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™, with a strong emphasis on the Brazilian and LATAM markets.

  • Work closely with the Partnership Sales team to deliver sponsorship and sales objectives, identifying and pursuing high-value sponsorship leads aligned with the commercial strategy of the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™.

  • Support the sales team research function, building compelling sales presentations utiliseing a range of internal and external data and partner case-studies.

  • Conduct in-depth desk and internet research.

  • Produce a range of materials (in collaboration with creative team) to support the sales managers throughout commercial discussions.

  • Become primary liaison with external suppliers and various internal research departments.

  • Support the sales team in sourcing, qualifying, and engaging potential sponsors, supporting generating tailored partnership proposals for major regional and international brands.

  • Ensure timely and accurate update and management of the CRM system for the FWWC27 Commercial team

  • Collaborate with the Strategy and Planning team to identify market opportunities and build compelling sales arguments.

  • Stay informed on emerging sponsorship categories, regional industry trends, and relevant market research, including pricing and inventory benchmarks.

  • Support the organisation of commercial events, conferences, hosting programmes, dedicated to cultivating business relationships and building into the sales pipeline.


Your Profile



  • Highly professional, articulate and results-driven.

  • Proven experience in similar roles within sponsorship sales, business development, or commercial partnerships, preferably in sports or entertainment.

  • Experience using consumer insights platforms (ex. GlobalWebIndex)

  • Exposure to media value reports and how they’re used in sponsorship

  • Familiarity with market research platforms and broader sponsorship market

  • Strong understanding of the Brazilian and LATAM commercial landscape.

  • Ability to work independently in a multi-task position within a dynamic, team-based environment.

  • Solutions orientated.

  • Solid time management and organizational skills.

  • Internal client oriented, efficient and effective.

  • Adept at handling and protecting confidential information.

  • Excellent team player and relationship builder.

  • Attention to detail, reliable and responsible.

  • An appreciation of the international sports federation environment, passion for women’s sports and global events.

  • University degree in business, sports marketing or related area

  • Excellent in Word / PowerPoint / Excel / PDF / MS Teams / Salesforce and other CRM tools

  • Fluent in English and Portuguese, any other FIFA language (Spanish especially) is an advantage

  • Ability to travel often and when required.

  • Right to work in Brazil.

  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

title: Integrity Engineer
description:
Job Function:

Employment Type: Permanent

Yinson is a dynamic, equal opportunity employer with great organisational culture where people are valued and empowered to deliverpowerful solutions.

Sumary:

Yinson Brasil Serviços Ltda is seeking a dedicated Integrity Engineer. This important role supports the onshore operations with a key focus on maintaining and assuring the integrity and safe operation of FPSOunits and associated equipment.

As an Integrity Engineer, you will play a pivotal role in safeguarding the company’s interests by ensuring all inspection, testing, and maintenance activities on critical equipment are carried out with high standards of safety, compliance, and efficiency. You will be integral to a team committed to operational excellence and proactive risk management within the offshore oil and gas sector.

Key Responsibilities

  • Organise and oversee the activities related to NR 13 / SPIE compliance in collaboration with equipment inspectors from FPSO units, including maintaining comprehensive and up-to-date documentation such as official books, calibration certificates, inspection reports, and audit records.
  • Manage internal and external inspection schedules, ensuring adherence to regulatory and company standards, while maintaining close coordination with operation managers to integrate inspection activities within shutdown plans effectively.
  • Lead the evaluation and implementation of training programs for Equipment Inspectors, Operators, and Technicians to uphold competency and safety standards across all levels of operations.
  • Maintain and regularly update the equipment master list to reflect current status and compliance details.
  • Define testing, measurement, replacements, repairs, and modification schedules based on written procedures, ensuring the physical condition of critical equipment meets operational safety requirements.
  • Ensure rigorous verification and performance testing of safety valves and other safety-critical equipment, either by performing, witnessing, or overseeing such tests to guarantee reliable operation.
  • Conduct audits of equipment manufacturers as required, supporting thorough supplier qualification and quality assurance.
  • Collaborate effectively with internal stakeholders (Yinson teams) and external parties (clients, contractors) to foster transparent communication and alignment on objectives and compliance requirements.
  • Perform additional duties as assigned by management in support of the company’s goals and regulatory compliance.
  • Commercial Awareness: Understand the wider business context and how operational integrity relates to company performance and risk management.
  • Safeguarding Company Interest: Demonstrate commitment to protecting company assets, reputation, and operational continuity.
  • Cost Control Experience: Apply cost control principles within offshore oil and gas projects to optimise expenditure without compromising safety or quality.
  • Teamwork: Work collaboratively across multi-disciplinary teams and with external partners, fostering a positive and productive working environment.
  • Communication Skills: Communicate effectively at all organisational levels, both verbally and in writing, ensuring clarity and professionalism in all interactions.
  • Analytical and Problem-Solving Abilities: Use strong analytical skills to assess equipment conditions, interpret inspection data, and develop practical solutions.
  • Attention to Detail: Maintain accuracy in documentation, procedures, and reporting to support compliance and operational excellence.
  • Responsibility and Proactivity: Take ownership of tasks, demonstrate initiative, and work in a hands‑on manner to achieve targets and resolve issues promptly.

Qualifications and Experience

  • Engineering degree is mandatory.
  • CREA‑RJ accreditation is required.
  • Post‑Graduation degree in a relevant field will be considered a strong advantage.
  • Experience as an Operations Engineer within the Brazilian oil and gas sector, with experience specifically in integrity engineering preferred.
  • Proven experience working with FPSO projects and offshore operations is highly desirable.
  • Fluent English and Portuguese verbal and written communication skills to effectively liaise with diverse teams and stakeholders.

Why Join Us?

At Yinson Brasil Serviços Ltda, you will become part of a forward‑thinking and inclusive team dedicated to safe and sustainable offshore operations. We value initiative and provide opportunities for professional growth within a dynamic sector. Our collaborative culture encourages knowledge sharing and continuous improvement, enabling you to make a tangible impact in a challenging and rewarding environment.

If you are a focused, detail‑oriented professional with a strong commitment to equipment integrity and operational safety, and you thrive in a team‑oriented setting, this role offers an excellent platform to advance your career in offshore production.

Position Summary

The Senior Manager, Human Resources LATAM serves as a strategic and tactical business partner to the LATAM team, driving the execution of HR strategies for the region. Reporting to the Director, Human Resources EMEA & SAL and based out of our factory in Rio de Janeiro, this role oversees all aspects of HR—including talent acquisition, compensation and benefits, learning and development, talent management, employee relations, policy design, and HR operations.

Operating as a primary business partner for the Rio manufacturing site and the wider regional business, the Senior Manager fosters a high-performance, employee-centric culture. This role emphasizes quality, productivity, and empowerment while ensuring all HR initiatives are aligned with global, regional, and local strategies to drive business success.

Key Responsibilities

Specific responsibilities include but are not limited to:

  • Strategic HR Leadership & Business Partnership
    • Provide HR leadership and functional support across multiple departments, including Operations, Sourcing, Sales, Customer Service, and Legal.

  • Partner with leadership and regional Talent Development to counsel on employee impact decisions, supporting workforce planning, succession, and development initiatives.

  • Manage talent engagement processes, including recruitment, compensation, promotions, training, and performance management, in partnership with the local HR team.
  • Support global mobility for key employees, collaborating with global mobility teams and HR peers.
  • Employee Engagement and culture
    • Cultivate a high-performance, inclusive work environment that aligns with Dover values and DFS’ company culture.
    • Support initiatives that enhance employee engagement, workplace satisfaction, and long-term retention.
  • Consult with business leaders to drive organizational design, change management, and leadership development strategies.
  • Diagnose workforce gaps and design solutions for regional and local implementation.
  • Oversee succession planning processes, fostering leadership development and career progression for key talent.
  • HR Operations, compliance & leadership
    • Manage, guide, and mentor HR team members based in Rio de Janeiro.
    • Ensure compliance with local labor laws and global HR requirements.
    • Develop and implement HR policies and procedures, ensuring alignment with corporate guidelines.
    • Monitor and manage key HR metrics, providing data-driven insights for business decisions.

Candidate Experience and Qualifications

The ideal candidate will bring strategic HR leadership at both local and regional levels, with experience in fast-paced, evolving business environment.

  • Bachelor’s degree in human resources management or business administration.
  • Experience in partnering with senior leadership teams.

  • Exceptional critical thinking skills: ability to decompose complex problems, prioritize issues, and implement sensible solutions.

  • Demonstrated ability to increase productivity and continuously improve methods, approaches.
  • Experience in organizational development and change management.
